metrics.profile_summary: MBA graduate specializing in Marketing with extensive certifications in digital marketing and business operations. Strong theoretical knowledge in omnichannel strategies and professional memberships in CIM and AMA.

experience.description: Managed customer inquiries, purchase orders, and import documentation. Coordinated between warehouse and accounts for GST invoicing and delivery fulfillment.
Managed export documentation, created invoices, and handled operational correspondence with business partners while providing internal IT support.

strengths: Highly certified in Meta, Google, and HubSpot marketing tools
Strong academic background with an MBA in Marketing
Professional affiliations with CIM and AMA
weaknesses: No professional experience in a dedicated marketing role
Work history is focused on inventory and accounting rather than campaign management
evaluation.summary: The candidate is technically over-prepared via certifications and education but lacks the required 2 years of professional marketing experience, as his career has been in logistics and accounting.
